body.sr: Otvorili smo Nook zato što nam je nedostajalo mesto na koje bismo i sami svraćali. Malo, tiho, sa pićem koje se ne pravi na brzinu.
body.en: We opened Nook because we missed having a place we would drop into ourselves. Small, quiet, with drinks that are not made in a hurry.

body.sr: Ako nas zateknete za šankom, to nije gostoprimstvo. Tu smo jer nam se tu sedi.
body.en: If you find us behind the bar, that is not hospitality. We are there because that is where we like to sit.
